gates.requiredScope: The exact intended Feature-030 candidate has no whitespace, missing-file, placeholder, generated-output, protected-source, dependency, package, or external-checkout defect.
gates.rationale: The staged candidate, including new files, is the delivery unit.

gates.requiredScope: Feature-024, Feature-028, Feature-029, and Feature-030 evidence validators pass on the reviewed head.
gates.rationale: Feature 030 extends shared audit evidence infrastructure.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Audit datasets, tests, or proof paths change.

gates.requiredScope: The full TuiVision solution passes in Release configuration.
gates.rationale: Shared test infrastructure and project-wide status evidence change.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any executable or project file changes.

gates.requiredScope: Core, Controls, Serialization, Compatibility, and Drivers.Console each retain at least 70 percent line coverage.
gates.rationale: The repository Constitution forbids merge below the five-assembly gate.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Coverage configuration, tests, or gate assemblies change.

gates.requiredScope: Generated documentation builds without warning or error for learner-facing audit and status changes.
gates.rationale: Feature 030 changes learner-facing Markdown and navigation-visible status.

gates.requiredScope: The generated DocFX site passes the Playwright and Axe accessibility smoke path.
gates.rationale: DocFX completion requires the matching A11Y path.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Generated pages, navigation, templates, or A11Y tests change.

gates.requiredScope: Secrets, dependencies, generated output, protected roots, external checkout, and audit-only scope remain clean.
gates.rationale: The audit must remain publishable and read-only toward protected inputs.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Candidate paths or dependency manifests change.

gates.requiredScope: Maintained agent and status surfaces agree on Feature-030 completion, computed next intake, and both wave blocks.
gates.rationale: Shared guidance and ordering are completion surfaces.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Agent guidance, Pflichtenheft, or processing order changes.

gates.requiredScope: The reviewed head executes the repository Release test command on Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows.
gates.rationale: Portable audit paths and repository policy require real multi-platform execution.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Workflow matrix or test command changes.

gates.requiredScope: The intentional interruption proves read-only status, implicit-continuation refusal, renewed authority, drift audit, and non-duplicating operation reconstruction.
gates.rationale: Feature 030 is the real random-phase hard-abort field validation.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Run-state, resume, or interrupted operation facts change.

gates.requiredScope: Review and thread convergence is verified directly through provider APIs rather than executed-command evidence.
gates.rationale: The exact-head gate schema validates technical commands; review state is a separate provider fact.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: A provider-neutral review-evidence schema is adopted.
